Device point size

device_pointsize.Rd

Every output device must be opened at this point size. It is not a text size - no text is drawn at 12 - but it is what fixes par("csi") at 0.2 inches, which is the unit for every spacing constant in the package (legend_lead, note_lead, title_lead, title_gap, legend_offset, axis_label_gap and all mar values). A device opened at a different point size renders the same chart with silently different spacing.

Usage

device_pointsize()

Value

numeric scalar
